company.shortDescription: Shipa is a digital logistics platform designed to help businesses company located in Dubai.
company.description: Shipa is a digital logistics platform that provides end-to-end shipping, e-commerce fulfillment, and last-mile delivery solutions for businesses and consumers. It enables users to manage freight, deliveries, and returns online with tracking and automation tools. Operating across the GCC and beyond, it supports cross-border trade and supply chain efficiency.
